title: Cohort Retention Analysis
interviewAnswer: Retention should compare users at the same age since cohort entry, not raw calendar activity. Cohort tables reveal whether product changes affect long-term engagement across acquisition periods.
keyPoints: Choose retention event and time grain.
Account for right-censoring of recent cohorts.
why: Cohort Retention Analysis appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: Retention should compare users at the same age since cohort entry, not raw calendar activity. Cohort tables reveal whether product changes affect long-term engagement across acquisition periods. Choose retention event and time grain. Account for right-censoring of recent cohorts. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Compare week-4 retention for signup cohorts rather than comparing total active users this month vs last month.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Cohort Retention Analysis make?
How would you validate or debug Cohort Retention Analysis in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
